components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single leading action in a task context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: var(--accent, #0b6b5d); color: #fff; font: 700 1rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #094d43; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(11,107,93,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A bordered utility or secondary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #d8dfda; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1e2528; font: 700 1rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #eef5ef; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(11,107,93,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Row
components.description: The current operational view inside the dark-green frame.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { width: 220px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; text-align: left; background: #314743; color: #fff; font: 600 1rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8ead5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Available Status
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 26px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #dff1df; color: #285c29; font: 700 .8rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A clear operational data entry field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #617071; font: 700 .78rem/1.4 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #d8dfda; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1e2528; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: none; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #0b6b5d; outline: 3px solid rgba(11,107,93,.14); }

narrative.overview: Rental Desk feels like a carefully maintained shared record: calm, accountable, and immediately usable. Its deep green frame, warm off-white work surfaces, restrained teal actions, consistent corners, and clear status colors support both dense staff workflows and simple member rental checks.
keyCharacteristics: Deep green navigation frame around pale working surfaces
Compact, predictable controls and data-dense layouts
Restrained accent color reserved for actions and focus
Responsive behavior that preserves task order and readability

rules.name: Reserved Accent
rules.body: Association Green marks action, selection, or focus; it does not become broad decoration inside the workspace.

rules.name: Operational Order
rules.body: Navigation, context, action, feedback, and records appear in that order at every viewport size.

rules.name: Earned Elevation
rules.body: A surface receives a shadow only when it temporarily sits above the main workflow.

rules.name: One Radius
rules.body: Use the eight-pixel control radius unless the element is explicitly nested or semantically a pill.

dos: Keep primary actions scarce and visually decisive.
Preserve equivalent hierarchy and meaning in English and German.
Use borders, alignment, and spacing to organize dense records.
donts: Add decorative gradients, glass effects, or ornamental imagery to operational views.
Use status colors for unrelated decoration.
Hide critical rental state behind hover-only interactions.
